note: Synthetic operator prompts written for issue 1038. No real operator prompt, no session transcript, no issue body, no customer content (plan R3, fleet-core data rule section 1). 'expected' is the saga command a competent operator would say the prompt warrants, or the literal 'none' when it warrants no command at all.

prompts.text: The login test started failing right after yesterday's merge and I have no idea why
prompts.why: A failure whose cause is unknown is the root-cause command's stated job.

prompts.text: Write up how we should build the new rate limiter before anyone touches code
prompts.why: Asks for the HOW as a durable artifact ahead of implementation.

prompts.text: Go build the caching layer we settled on last week
prompts.why: A settled decision plus an instruction to execute it.

prompts.text: Read through the diff on my branch and tell me whether it is safe to merge
prompts.why: Names a diff and a merge-safety question.

prompts.text: We finished the migration campaign, capture what we learned from it
prompts.why: Finished work plus a request to turn it into durable knowledge.

prompts.text: Turn this vague ask into something precise enough to put on the backlog
prompts.why: Interrogating a vague ask into a backlog-ready WHAT.

prompts.text: Give me a spread of ideas for what to do about the flaky test suite
prompts.why: Asks for divergent idea generation, not one answer.

prompts.text: I am not even sure this is the right problem to be solving
prompts.why: The frame itself is in question, which is the front door's job.

prompts.text: Take this one idea and work it up into a proper requirements document
prompts.why: One chosen idea deepened into a requirements doc.

prompts.text: Where should this repository be heading over the next quarter
prompts.why: Sets the durable direction anchor; /strategy owns STRATEGY.md.

prompts.text: Check that this plan document is actually ready to hand to an implementer
prompts.why: Implementation-readiness of a plan document.

prompts.text: Is the scope of this ambitious enough, or are we playing it too safe
prompts.why: Strategy, ambition and positioning judged from a founder's seat.

prompts.text: Cap the model tier for the rest of this run without re-planning it
prompts.why: There is no command for this any more. Issue 1030 removed /tier; the run record's staffing answers, set once at admission, are where a run's tiers live.

prompts.text: Run the acceptance checks against the deployed build
prompts.why: Quality and acceptance checks on a shipped thing.

prompts.text: Coordinate this whole multi-card outcome as one dependency graph
prompts.why: There is no command for this any more. Issue 1030 removed /outcome; a parent issue with children gets a parent branch, and the children merge onto it by merge turn.

prompts.text: What time is it in Tokyo right now?
prompts.why: An ordinary question with no lifecycle work behind it.

prompts.text: Rename the variable tmp to buffer in this one file
prompts.why: A one-line mechanical edit; no lifecycle command earns its overhead.

prompts.text: Thanks, that worked
prompts.why: An acknowledgement carrying no request at all.

prompts.text: What does the acronym TLS stand for?
prompts.why: A definition lookup.

prompts.text: Add a trailing newline to the end of this config file
prompts.why: A trivial file edit.
